hypothesis: Offloading durable attempt-log I/O frees the asyncio loop during disk/lock stalls while preserving persistence-before-entry, post-await intent validation, truthful outcomes and bounded cleanup reporting.
evidence_prompt: Iteration 5 recorded a 612.5 ms watchdog interval, sampled inside synchronous telemetry os.replace. This does not isolate replace duration or prove a missed interruption.
scope: Attempt logger only. Preserve snapshot format, locks and durability; keep arbitrary legacy callbacks and event sinks synchronous. No model/audio tuning.
acceptance: Existing telemetry/crash/upstream collection regressions remain passing
Event-loop witness runs while start and completion logging are held
Correction or close during start prevents backend entry and releases the ledger reservation
Late saved cancelled intention is retained/finalized, with owned work and observed errors
Known completion stays done during logging cancellation or timeout
Shutdown reports pending telemetry without inventing unknown effects; native disk threads are not claimed stopped
Attempt identity and argument bytes remain stable across the new await boundary

planned_comparison.method: Fresh subprocess per condition; existing synchronous executor versus candidate. Real FDBToolLogger with a declared 100 ms sleep injected before os.replace for start or finish. asyncio ticker every 5 ms while a single successful no-op mock write runs.
planned_comparison.limitations: Fault injection and no-op backend; not a repeat of the observed storage cause, live RTC latency, microphone interaction or throughput. All runs retained; no threshold tuning.
